author: masonproffitt
body: This adds a `model` directory for SONIC/Triton and includes the configuration file needed for the MLPF model. This will be needed for adding a SONIC producer for MLPF, which will be done in a CMSSW PR to be opened right after this one. The configuration file here is copied from https://github.com/jpata/cmssw/pull/70.
title: Add SONIC configuration for MLPF
